titolo: Anthropic donates Agent Skills standard to Agentic AI Foundation
descr: Anthropic moves the open Agent Skills standard to the Linux‑backed AAIF, keeping it community‑driven and vendor‑neutral.
paragrafi: Anthropic announced on 22 October 2026 that it is transferring the Agent Skills open standard to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF).
The AAIF operates under the Linux Foundation, which Anthropic co‑founded with Block and OpenAI in 2025.
Agent Skills, first released in December 2025, let AI agents access specialized knowledge and workflows via a folder containing a SKILL.md file and supporting scripts.
perche: The move secures a neutral home for Agent Skills, ensuring continued openness and community input. Users of AI agents can expect ongoing compatibility, while developers of free or locally‑run models gain a stable, vendor‑neutral specification to build on.
